snippet.title: Steam Ys Foliage Ocean in Celceta : Kai Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Ys Foliage Ocean in Celceta is equipped with several unique systems carried over from Ys VIII, including auto-mapping and Flash Move, a technique that allows players to dodge enemy attacks at the last possible moment.

Based on the PlayStation®4 version, a significant upgrade from the PlayStation®Vita version that supported frame rates of 60 fps, improved quality textures, and clearer in-game background music, the Steam® version features even higher quality visuals for a more immersive gameplay experience. The Steam® version is also compatible with the Steam Deck 16:10 display.


Title: Ys Foliage Ocean in Celceta : Kai 
Genre: Action RPG
Console: Steam®
Release Date: Coming in Spring 2024
Languages
　Audio: Japanese
　Subtitles: Traditional Chinese/Korean
Steam® Page: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2605720
